text: Over in the science world, researchers are still hard at it trying to build a better sunscreen, one that protects us without giving the coral a hard time. It sounds like a small thing but it could make a real difference for reef health long term.

speaker: alice
text: It's clever stuff too, they're looking at how certain coral species bounce back from stress, hoping to breed a bit of extra toughness into the reef for the warmer years ahead. Bit like giving the reef its own version of a gym membership.

speaker: charlie
